from service.config import Settings, parse_domains
from service.core.validation import destination_is_blocked, is_blocked_host

BLOCKED = frozenset({"phish.example", "bad.test"})


def test_parse_domains_normalises():
    assert parse_domains(" Phish.Example. , ,bad.test") == BLOCKED
    assert parse_domains("") == frozenset()
    assert Settings(blocked_domains="a.com,b.com").blocked_domain_set == {"a.com", "b.com"}


def test_blocked_host_matches_domain_and_subdomains_only():
    assert is_blocked_host("phish.example", BLOCKED)
    assert is_blocked_host("login.PHISH.example.", BLOCKED)
    assert not is_blocked_host("notphish.example", BLOCKED)
    assert not is_blocked_host("phish.example.com", BLOCKED)


def test_destination_is_blocked():
    assert destination_is_blocked("https://www.bad.test/x", BLOCKED)
    assert not destination_is_blocked("https://good.example/x", BLOCKED)
    assert not destination_is_blocked("https://bad.test/x", frozenset())

import pytest
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient

from service.config import Settings
from service.main import create_app


@pytest.fixture
def guarded():
    app = create_app(Settings(database_url="sqlite://", blocked_domains="phish.example"))
    yield TestClient(app, follow_redirects=False)
    app.state.engine.dispose()


@pytest.mark.parametrize("url", ["https://phish.example/login", "http://secure.phish.example/"])
def test_blocked_destinations_cannot_be_shortened(guarded, url):
    r = guarded.post("/api/v1/urls", json={"url": url})
    assert r.status_code == 422
    assert r.json()["detail"] == "destination domain is blocked"


def test_other_destinations_still_work(guarded):
    r = guarded.post("/api/v1/urls", json={"url": "https://phish.example.org/ok"})
    assert r.status_code == 201
